title.en: A farm offers produce by SMS with the harvest date

goal.en: FARM is an OFFER with origin farm. A harvest date HV, a best-before BB and the storage code are the whole message; the gateway records the offer and the rule packs read the origin and date later.

note.en: A cooperative offers 120 kg of tomatoes, ambient, harvested 4 November.
The same offer with a best-before date instead; this is the message recorded in the robot-kitchen example flow.
A plain OFFER may also carry HV. The item words imply the food class egg, which the storage checks use.
Day 32 of month 13 is not a date: the gateway answers bad_date and writes nothing.
The recorded offer for the robot-kitchen flow, checked with the basic food-safety pack: ambient produce with a date mark in the future, no findings.

outcome.en: You can offer produce from a basic phone and know what the gateway records. Next: scenario 061 claims an offer.
